% hypcap without options, with a manual \capstart in a figure and a table,
% and a figure without one: each number, \ref, and \autoref as in the PDF,
% and each link landing in its float.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{hypcap}
\begin{document}
\begin{figure}[h]
  \capstart
  \centering
  \fbox{One}
  \caption{First figure}\label{fig:one}
\end{figure}
\begin{figure}[h]
  \centering
  \fbox{Two}
  \caption{Second figure}\label{fig:two}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
  \capstart
  \centering
  \caption{First table}\label{tab:one}
  \begin{tabular}{c}1\end{tabular}
\end{table}

Ref: \ref{fig:one}; \ref{fig:two}; \ref{tab:one}.

Autoref: \autoref{fig:one}; \autoref{fig:two}; \autoref{tab:one}.
\end{document}
